title: Expected fraction of identifiable tryptic peptides containing cysteine, for the proteins that protein-level persulfide capture would return
why: Fan et al. 2020 (10.1126/sciadv.abb6477) and the 2021 Comment (10.1126/sciadv.abe7006) disagree about the expected value of this fraction. Neither computed it from a proteome under the stated protease. It is computable in silico.
quantity: Q = identifiable peptides containing >=1 Cys / identifiable peptides, over proteins with >=1 Cys
why_missed_cleavages_are_not_chosen: Fan et al. state no search-engine missed-cleavage setting anywhere in their paper (full text read 2026-09-20: no Mascot, MaxQuant or Proteome Discoverer mention, no missed-cleavage statement); the Comment objects that their conditions are underdescribed. All three settings are therefore reported and a directional verdict requires all three to agree.

estimators.primary: Q_pool, peptides pooled across proteins, matching Fan's Table 2
estimators.dedup: peptides deduplicated by sequence within a protein; no-dedup reported as sensitivity

comparison_target: Fan's observed workflow-1 counts, extracted mechanically from the table elements of the article XML; never transcribed by hand

minimum_meaningful_difference.anchor: Fan's own Fig. 3 calls ratios of 0.58x, 1.81x and 1.17x 'close to theoretical levels'. A factor the disputing authors treat as agreement cannot be one we treat as disagreement.

branches.B1: interval for Q_pool CONTAINS the observed pooled fraction at MC 0,1,2 -> the observed fraction is what perfect protein-level capture predicts; Fan's workflow-1 inference does not follow. Does NOT say ProPerDP is specific.
branches.B2: interval lies entirely ABOVE the observed value AND ratio >= MMD at MC 0,1,2 -> Fan's workflow-1 inference is quantitatively supported on this axis.
branches.B3: branches disagree across MC or between estimators, or the interval lies entirely BELOW the observed value -> report the sensitivity table, make no directional claim.

sentence_written_regardless_of_branch: The dispute turns on the expected value of this fraction under the digestion geometry, a quantity computable in silico from the proteome and the stated protease, which neither party computed.
will_not_decide: workflow 2: both parties agree its expectation is ~100% and that the observed value is anomalous; they disagree about the wet-lab cause, which is not computable
whether either paper is right or wrong overall; no position on persulfidation biology
expected yield: Limitation 4 of this manuscript applies, so Q is an upper bound on the identifiable fraction
no intensity weighting; Fan's Table 2 counts peptides, so Q counts peptides

controls.PC1: reproduce Fan's published in-silico values 4.5 / 6.9 / 11.5% for Rdl2, OxyR(4C->A), psGFP1.1. Diagnostic, not gating; fewer than two matches caps the verdict at B3.
controls.PC3: proteins with zero Cys give Q = 0 exactly
controls.PC4: the imported rule reproduces this tree's stored anchor 51,404 / 62,187 = 0.8266 at MC=2; otherwise the imported module is not the manuscript's rule and the round stops
controls.NC1: within-protein residue permutation (seed 20260920) measures how much of Q is composition rather than cleavage geometry; reported, not gating

proteomes.primary: UP000000625 E. coli K-12 MG1655 (the strain of Fan's Table 2 parallel workflow-1 samples)
